candidate_contract: Current manuscript SRC with no heteroskedastic initialization; KL variant changes only confidence/reference quantities explicitly defined by the requested notes.
direct_variant_comparisons: SRC-KL minus SRC at the same preference and service budget, with paired environments and repetitions.

multiplicity.families: Separate, prespecified group x suite x metric families; all comparator contrasts in each family retained.
multiplicity.reward: Each reward candidate minus each of 19 comparators
multiplicity.joint: Primary lambda=.6 candidates, matched widest/LUCB controls, and direct same-mode KL-SRC comparisons. Tradeoff curves at other modes are descriptive.
multiplicity.tail: Independent seed cohort; prespecified six layouts, two laws, 128 paired replications; descriptive pooled quantiles with no per-cell extreme-quantile claims.

pairing: Common arm/pull-number streams within a cell and repetition; reused R trajectories receive both reward and joint tags only on the joint-law/repetition subset.
aggregation: Equal weight per fixed layout x law cell within each group; no pooled weighting that lets repeated layouts or extra repetitions dominate.
smoke: Separate derivative cohort, excluded from scientific summaries and winner claims.

comparator_scope_revision.decision: User-requested removal before regenerating the final small-study outputs.
comparator_scope_revision.excluded_scope: All prefix-restricted ballooning MOSS configurations and their aliases.
comparator_scope_revision.reason: Restricting admission to an initial prefix can ignore a later-arriving optimal arm and allow linear dynamic regret in the permanent-arrival model.
comparator_scope_revision.selection_basis: Comparator suitability specified by the user, not filtering according to wins or losses in this study.
comparator_scope_revision.preserved: All other algorithms, layouts, reward laws, seeds and replication counts.
